thread:
mike_release: Quick sync: target coordinated deploy tonight 23:00 PDT within quiet window. Components: runtime->v1.8.2 (KV tweaks), router header-strip flag, console schema bump. We should pin API to v2.3.0 for canary so console doesn't pull incompatible fields. Any objections?

vijay_runtime: runtime thumbs up for v1.8.2. Note: KV eviction param defaults changed — we'll set KV_EVICT_TTL explicitly. Recommend warm cache and prefetch for canary nodes.

jess_console: Console schema is generally compatible but analytics mapping can break on older payloads -> possible ingestion 5xxs. Suggest gating analytics fields and adding a smoke test.

charlie_router: Header-strip toggle ready, plan to enable on a router-canary flag only. I'll create flag router-canary-23. Need automated compatibility check for headers -> do we have one?

sara_dev: I can run a quick e2e against staging with pinned api v2.3.0 + console schema bump. How long is the canary window?

mike_release: Canary plan: 20% for 15m -> 50% for 30m -> full. Rollback criteria: p95 latency +30ms over baseline OR error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m. Immediate rollback if ingestion 5xx spikes.

deploybot: @channel Deploybot will start the canary in ~10m. Manifest: runtime:v1.8.2, router:header_strip=canary, console:v1.5.4-schema, api:v2.3.0-pinned. Logs to #release-logs. :rocket:

vijay_runtime: For canary env vars: KV_EVICT_TTL=60, KV_PREFETCH=on. Emit metrics runtime.kv.evictions and runtime.kv.hit_ratio to canary dashboard.

jess_console: Add 'console-schema-smoke' regression suite to preflight (analytics mapping + null fallbacks).

charlie_router: Enabling header-strip only on router-canary-23 cluster. Will not touch main routers until green.

sara_dev: starting e2e now with pinned API, will paste failures.

sara_dev: e2e found ingestion spike -> analytics mapper NPEs causing intermittent 5xxs. Log snippet: ```ERROR analytics.mapper.MapTransformer - NullPointer at MapTransformer.java:68
payload: {"events": 23, "user": null}```

mike_release: Stop advancing traffic. Hold rollout. Rollback console schema in canary to v1.5.3. We need a quick patch to guard null and add test coverage.

deploybot: Rolling back console in canary to v1.5.3 now. Pausing traffic shifts and canary progression. Will update when complete.

vijay_runtime: Watching canary dashboards. If p95 > 200ms or error rate >0.5% i'll trigger autoscale and alert oncall.

mike_release: Actions: 1) gate analytics schema in release notes and checklist; 2) require api pin in console deploy spec; 3) add console-schema-smoke to deploybot preflight; 4) patch mapper NPE and ship v1.5.4-1; 5) re-run canary after patch. I'll open follow-up ticket.

deploybot: console rollback complete in canary. Traffic frozen. Notifying @release-team. :white_check_mark:
